name: production-operation-approval

blocks.title: Production consequence
blocks.message: This can reduce service capacity. Verify current health, rollback ownership, and change window before approving.

payload.consequence: Authorize an external operator to reduce production-service-group-a from 6 to 4 instances. Commentary will not execute, schedule, or verify the operation.

expectedConsequence: An external operator may reduce production-service-group-a from 6 to 4 instances only with exact current approval and established connector authorization. Commentary does not perform or verify it.
